meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 装上后，进行安全审计时 Claude 会调用 Centinela 代理，检查 OWASP Top 10、认证授权、数据保护、硬编码密钥与依赖漏洞；有 Solidity 还查智能合约，最后写报告并给出通过/需修改结论。
howto.when: 用户通过 /security-audit 命令发起审计时才触发；典型用在发布前、涉及认证/授权/数据处理的大改动后，或新增依赖时。

say.text: 对 src/payments/ 文件夹做一次安全审计。
say.note: 会生成针对该目录的审计报告。

say.text: 扫描项目里的硬编码密钥和已知漏洞依赖。
say.note: 执行密钥扫描和依赖 CVE 检查。

say.text: 发布前检查一下代码安全状态。
say.note: 触发 OWASP、认证授权等安全检查。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Centinela agent for security audits: OWASP Top 10, auth, authorization, data protection, secret scanning, dependency CVEs; smart contracts if Solidity; writes a report with verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered by the /security-audit command (optionally scoped); recommended before releases, after significant auth/authz/data changes, or when adding dependencies.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on the src/payments/ folder.
Scan the project for hardcoded secrets and known vulnerable dependencies.
say_en.note: Runs secret scan and dependency CVE check.

say_en.text: Check code security status before release.
say_en.note: Runs OWASP, auth, and other security checks.
